introduction.text: Bennu is a dark asteroid with an equatorial ridge and a surface crowded with boulders.

normal.title: PolyCam reflectance mosaic
normal.summary: Corrected reflectance from about 55° north to 55° south; the poles were not observed.

surface.title: PolyCam 5 cm image basemap
surface.summary: A 5 cm basemap with photographed shadows; its control shape differs slightly from the display mesh.

spectral.title: MapCam spectral composite
spectral.summary: Published false-color MapCam composite that emphasizes spectral differences.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Height above or below a 241 m sphere. Colors mix the overall shape with local relief.

blue.title: OSIRIS-REx MapCam · 473 nm
blue.summary: Brightness in blue light, corrected for illumination. All bands share one scale; gray marks missing data.

green.title: OSIRIS-REx MapCam · 550 nm
green.summary: Brightness in green light, corrected for illumination. All bands share one scale; gray marks missing data.

red.title: OSIRIS-REx MapCam · 698 nm
red.summary: Brightness in red light, corrected for illumination. All bands share one scale; gray marks missing data.

near-infrared.title: OSIRIS-REx MapCam · 847 nm
near-infrared.summary: Brightness in near infrared light, corrected for illumination. All bands share one scale; gray marks missing data.

geopotential.title: OLA geopotential height
geopotential.summary: Height above the lowest point of the surface potential, with Bennu’s spin; material moves from high to low.

slope.title: OLA slope relative to gravity
slope.summary: Surface tilt against gravity plus spin, from the laser shape and a uniform-density model.

gravity-anomaly.title: Gravity anomaly map
gravity-anomaly.summary: Measured surface gravity minus a uniform-density Bennu, in percent; positive is stronger than uniform.

thermal-inertia.title: OTES thermal inertia
thermal-inertia.summary: How slowly the surface heats and cools; low values mark porous boulders. Gray marks facets with no fit.

hydration.title: OVIRS 2.7 µm band depth
hydration.summary: Strength of the absorption of water-bearing clay minerals. Gray marks facets with no value.

carbon.title: OVIRS 3.4 µm band area
carbon.summary: Strength of the absorption linked to organics and carbonates; not an abundance. Gray marks facets with no value.
